answer: Re-execute one in eight receipts on three independent nodes. Divergence dilutes the payout by 0.3 per dissenting report. Rewards vest across 24 epochs against future work, so a new identity sees its first payout after 24 closes. An operator mapping 1,000 clones needs 125 re-executions per 1,000 items and 24 epochs of patience per clone. The atlas of that cost is the defense: a dune of fake work still has to be re-run, and the oasis of vesting stays 24 epochs away.
